notes: The provisional dashboard query takes routed club ID, normalized authenticated email and selected group ID, returns either `{:ok, dashboard, replacement_interests}` or the existing forbidden/not-found error, and rereads active-club authority through `load/3` on bind, rebind and matching notifications. Its interests cover selected-club members/groups/conversations, current-person participating groups, selected-group members/conversations/access, represented Club/Group/Person/membership/message/conversation identities, represented-member role assignments, and separate current-actor permissions, with route rebind replacing old selected-group scopes. The app-private source maps Club, Membership, Person, Group, GroupMembership, Role, Message and ConversationGroupAccess notifications to exact scopes and documented family/club/global fallbacks; Message emits exact conversation plus conservative club-conversation invalidation, while MemberEmailDelivery is ignored. MemberDashboardLive now delegates subscription, notification matching and rereads to Binding, synchronizes only page title and targeted-member coordination, and retains active section, picker/form, operations, access-request, flash and navigation state. Initial TDD runs failed because the new source and descriptor did not yet exist, and targeted loops exposed test-fixture ordering, no-primary-key deletion and authoritative group-name assumptions that were corrected. No conversation-detail migration, API freeze, package extraction, cross-surface adapter completion, domain/projector write, acceptance feature, staff stream, Docker or quality-gate change was introduced.
